items.briefing:
Two threats are worth your attention today. A flaw in Zimbra email software is being actively exploited, meaning attackers are taking advantage of it right now — if your organisation uses Zimbra, patching needs to happen urgently, not at the next scheduled maintenance window. Separately, a new malware strain called WordlistLoader hides itself inside plain text files, so staff should be cautious about opening unexpected text attachments, even ones that look harmless.

There are also reports of a maturing banking trojan, ToxicPanda, now targeting business environments, which could pose risks to staff accessing financial systems. **Practical tip:** Never open unexpected file attachments — even plain text files — without first confirming the sender through a separate channel.

featured.title: Exploited Zimbra Flaw Highlights Shrinking Window to Patch
